name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
summary: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines allows wide testamentary freedom, with no reserved share and no inheritance tax per a commercial guide. Common-law trusts apply. No private foundation law was found and the Hague Trusts Convention is not in force.
foreign_law_note: No source read states the conflict rule for a foreign national's estate. Common-law rule: movables follow the law of the domicile, land follows local law. Not confirmed in local statute for this jurisdiction.
trust_note: Not in the HCCH status table. Wills fall under the Wills Act, Cap. 495 and intestacy under the Intestates Estates Act (commercial guide). No trust statute or foundation law was read.
open_questions: Only a commercial blog was found; the statutes were not read.
Existence of international trust or foundation statutes not confirmed.
Private foundations: no source found either way; not finding a foundation law is not evidence that there is none.
